the participants in this study were experiencing multiple dimensions of food insecurity, including hunger and obesity.

the food environment in peri urban areas of South Africa has changed, resulting in food insecurity and obesity, which are interconnected and should be considered together in health promotion interventions.
the food environment of peri urban residents of South Africa is characterized by food insecurity, which is associated with obesity, but not with dietary choice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the food environments of peri urban residents shape their diets and their health.
how the food environments in peri urban areas of Cape Town are changing, and how these changes impact on residents' food security.
the interrelationship between food insecurity and obesity in the context of peri urban South Africa.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
food insecurity in peri urban South Africa is a major factor in the development of obesity and diet related NCD.
the participants' experiences of food insecurity were related to their obesity, and that this was a result of their lack of economic access to food.
the food insecurity in peri urban areas is a major contributing factor to obesity and other diet related NCD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

obesity in peri urban areas in South Africa is not only related to dietary choice and lack of nutrition education, but also related to lack of economic access to food and the food environment, as well as the social environment, and the social determinants of health.
the current obesity interventions are not addressing the root causes of the problem.
the food insecurity in the context of obesity in the peri urban areas of Cape Town is a major public health concern.
The main takeaway from our work is that
obesity and hunger are not mutually exclusive.
obesity interventions should not be framed solely as a problem of choice.
food insecurity is a complex and multifaceted phenomenon, with multiple dimensions and drivers.
